CK_FITS.en: In this illness, has the child had fits (jerking they could not stop, eyes rolling, body stiff)? Reply 1 yes, fits. 2 no fits. 3 not sure.
CK_FITS.sw: Katika ugonjwa huu, mtoto amepata degedege (kutetemeka bila kuzuia, macho kuzunguka, mwili kukakamaa)? Jibu 1 ndio, degedege. 2 hana degedege. 3 sina uhakika.
CK_FITS.back: During this illness, has the child had convulsions (shaking without control, eyes rolling, body becoming stiff)? Reply 1 yes, convulsions. 2 has no convulsions. 3 I am not sure.

CK_WAKE.en: Call the child's name and touch gently. Do not shake. Reply 1 if they do not wake or fall back asleep at once. 2 if awake and looking at you. 3 not sure.
CK_WAKE.sw: Mwite mtoto kwa jina lake na mguse taratibu. Usimtikise. Jibu 1 kama haamki au analala tena mara moja. 2 yuko macho na anakutazama. 3 sina uhakika.
CK_WAKE.back: Call the child by their name and touch them gently. Do not shake them. Reply 1 if they do not wake up or fall asleep again at once. 2 they are awake and looking at you. 3 I am not sure.

CK_DRINK.en: Only if the child is awake: offer a drink or the breast, do not force. Reply 1 cannot drink or suck at all, or not awake. 2 drinks or sucks. 3 not sure.
CK_DRINK.sw: Mtoto akiwa macho tu: mjaribu kumpa kinywaji au titi, usilazimishe. Jibu 1 hawezi kunywa/kunyonya kabisa, au hayuko macho. 2 ananywa/ananyonya. 3 sina uhakika.
CK_DRINK.back: Only when the child is awake: try to give him/her a drink or the breast, do not force. Reply 1 cannot drink/suckle at all, or is not awake. 2 is drinking/suckling. 3 I am not sure.

CK_VOMIT.en: Since this illness began, does the child vomit up every drink and feed? Reply 1 vomits everything. 2 keeps some down. 3 not sure.
CK_VOMIT.sw: Tangu ugonjwa huu uanze, mtoto hutapika kila anachokunywa au kula? Jibu 1 hutapika kila kitu. 2 hubakisha vingine. 3 sina uhakika.
CK_VOMIT.back: Since this illness began, does the child vomit everything he/she drinks or eats? Reply 1 vomits everything. 2 keeps some things down. 3 I am not sure.

CK_BLOOD.en: Look at the child's last stool (poo). Reply 1 if you see blood, red or dark. 2 no blood. 3 not sure or no stool.
CK_BLOOD.sw: Angalia kinyesi cha mwisho cha mtoto. Jibu 1 ukiona damu, rangi nyekundu au nyeusi. 2 hakuna damu. 3 sina uhakika au hakuna kinyesi.
CK_BLOOD.back: Check the child's last stool. Reply 1 if you see blood, red or black color. 2 no blood. 3 I am not sure or no stool.

CK_COUGH_DAYS.en: Has the cough lasted 14 days or more? Reply 1 yes, 14 days or more. 2 less than 14 days. 3 not sure.
CK_COUGH_DAYS.sw: Kikohozi kimekaa siku 14 au zaidi? Jibu 1 ndio, siku 14 au zaidi. 2 chini ya siku 14. 3 sina uhakika.
CK_COUGH_DAYS.back: Has the cough lasted 14 days or more? Reply 1 yes, 14 days or more. 2 less than 14 days. 3 I am not sure.

CK_DIARRHOEA_DAYS.en: Has the diarrhoea lasted 14 days or more? Reply 1 yes, 14 days or more. 2 less than 14 days. 3 not sure.
CK_DIARRHOEA_DAYS.sw: Kuharisha kumedumu siku 14 au zaidi? Jibu 1 ndiyo, siku 14 au zaidi. 2 chini ya siku 14. 3 sina uhakika.
CK_DIARRHOEA_DAYS.back: Has diarrhea lasted 14 days or more? Reply 1 yes, 14 days or more. 2 less than 14 days. 3 I am not sure.

CK_FEVER_DAYS.en: Has the fever lasted 7 days or more, counted from when it started, even on and off? Reply 1 yes. 2 less. 3 not sure.
CK_FEVER_DAYS.sw: Homa imekaa siku 7 au zaidi, ukihesabu tangu ilipoanza, hata kama inakuja na kuisha? Jibu 1 ndio. 2 chini ya 7. 3 sina uhakika.
CK_FEVER_DAYS.back: Has the fever lasted 7 days or more, counting from when it started, even if it comes and goes? Reply 1 yes. 2 less than 7. 3 I am not sure.

Q_ACK_TOLD.en: Thank you, your answer was passed on. If no one calls or comes by {time}, go to {facility}. Go NOW if a danger sign appears.
Q_ACK_TOLD.sw: Asante, jibu lako limefikishwa. Ikiwa hakuna mtu atakayepiga simu au kuja kufikia saa {time}, nenda {facility}. Ukiona dalili ya hatari, nenda SASA HIVI.
Q_ACK_TOLD.back: Thank you, your reply has been delivered. If no one calls or comes by {time}, go to {facility}. If you see a danger sign, go RIGHT NOW.
